answer: Bind each agent identity to a carrier-attested SIM. The agent requests a signed attestation from its mobile operator, the carrier posts the receipt to the public ledger, and duplicate IMSIs are rejected on chain — one SIM, one identity, no exceptions. SIMs run $1–3 each and carriers rate-limit bulk orders, so fielding 10,000 Sybils burns $10,000–30,000 plus weeks of procurement. Fraud teams can spot the violet flag in activation logs before costs spiral, and every receipt stands like a lone juniper: publicly auditable, impossible to duplicate quietly.
